skills.name: Send a photo
skills.trigger: the user asks to share a picture
guardrails: confirm before sending
never pick a contact that was not named

skills.name: Navigate home
skills.trigger: the user asks for directions home
guardrails: never start navigation while driving is detected
confirm the destination before starting

skills.name: Quiet the phone
skills.trigger: the user asks to silence the phone
guardrails: reversible actions only
report the exact new volume

skills.name: Reply on WhatsApp
skills.trigger: the user asks to reply to a named person on WhatsApp
guardrails: never send without an explicit confirmation
do not guess a contact on a weak match

skills.name: Find a downloaded file
skills.trigger: the user asks where a recent download is
guardrails: do not open an executable file
report ambiguity instead of choosing silently

skills.name: Capture a receipt
skills.trigger: the user asks to save or read a receipt
steps: request screen capture consent if needed
guardrails: never upload the screenshot unless the user attached it to a run
delete the frame when done

skills.name: Start a ride booking
skills.trigger: the user asks for a ride
guardrails: never confirm a payment or a ride without explicit confirmation
report the quoted price first

skills.name: Research in the browser
skills.trigger: the user asks for a fact that needs a web page
steps: extract the answer with its source
guardrails: cite the URL
never submit a form or a purchase

skills.name: Research a task before acting
skills.trigger: a task in an unfamiliar app or an undocumented flow
steps: web_search for how the task is done in this app
act with verify steps between each action
guardrails: never act on a guess — look or ask first
verify the search result matches the real app version

skills.name: Act without a mapped screen
skills.trigger: a new app or settings page with no recorded layout
steps: navigate by deep link or system_intent if one exists
pick actions consistent with the visible UI tree only
guardrails: do not tap any element you cannot see
stop and ask_user if the tree is ambiguous

skills.name: How to run a task well
steps: research the task if anything is unfamiliar
report the outcome and the evidence
guardrails: never report success without evidence
always end_session with outcome and summary
